text: This report submits the Toronto Zoo 2026 Operating Plan and Budget for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the 2026 Operating Plan and Budget on 2025-09-23 and recommended it for approval by the Board.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2026 Operating Plan and Budget as described in the report (September 24, 2025) from the Chief Transformation Officer, Toronto Zoo.
